#include "core/message_bus.h"
#include "agent_config.h"
#include "agent_compat.h"

#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <pthread.h>

static const char *TAG = "bus";

/* -- Private Types -------------------------------------------------------- */

typedef struct {
    agent_msg_t  items[AGENT_BUS_QUEUE_LEN];
    int             head;
    int             tail;
    int             count;
    pthread_mutex_t lock;
    pthread_cond_t  not_empty;
    pthread_cond_t  not_full;
} msg_queue_t;

/* -- Private Data --------------------------------------------------------- */

static msg_queue_t g_inbound_queue;
static msg_queue_t g_outbound_queue;
static bool g_initialized = false;
static volatile bool g_bus_shutdown = false;

/* -- Private Functions ---------------------------------------------------- */

static void msg_queue_init(msg_queue_t *queue)
{
    memset(queue, 0, sizeof(*queue));
    pthread_mutex_init(&queue->lock, NULL);
    pthread_cond_init(&queue->not_empty, NULL);
    pthread_cond_init(&queue->not_full, NULL);
}

static void msg_queue_destroy(msg_queue_t *queue)
{
    pthread_mutex_destroy(&queue->lock);
    pthread_cond_destroy(&queue->not_empty);
    pthread_cond_destroy(&queue->not_full);
    memset(queue, 0, sizeof(*queue));
}

static int msg_queue_push(msg_queue_t *queue, const agent_msg_t *msg,
                          uint32_t timeout_ms)
{
    struct timespec ts;

    pthread_mutex_lock(&queue->lock);

    if (queue->count >= AGENT_BUS_QUEUE_LEN) {
        if (timeout_ms == 0) {
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&queue->lock);
            return ERROR;
        }

        clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &ts);
        ts.tv_sec += (time_t)(timeout_ms / 1000);
        ts.tv_nsec += (long)((timeout_ms % 1000) * 1000000L);
        if (ts.tv_nsec >= 1000000000L) {
            ts.tv_sec++;
            ts.tv_nsec -= 1000000000L;
        }

        /* Wait for space */
        while (queue->count >= AGENT_BUS_QUEUE_LEN) {
            if (pthread_cond_timedwait(&queue->not_full, &queue->lock, &ts) != 0) {
                pthread_mutex_unlock(&queue->lock);
                syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[%s] Queue full, dropping message\n", TAG);
                return ERROR;
            }
        }
    }

    queue->items[queue->tail] = *msg;
    queue->tail = (queue->tail + 1) % AGENT_BUS_QUEUE_LEN;
    queue->count++;

    pthread_cond_signal(&queue->not_empty);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&queue->lock);
    return OK;
}

static int msg_queue_pop(msg_queue_t *queue, agent_msg_t *msg,
                         uint32_t timeout_ms)
{
    struct timespec ts;

    pthread_mutex_lock(&queue->lock);

    while (queue->count == 0) {
        if (g_bus_shutdown) {
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&queue->lock);
            return ERROR;
        }
        if (timeout_ms == UINT32_MAX) {
            pthread_cond_wait(&queue->not_empty, &queue->lock);
        } else {
            clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &ts);
            ts.tv_sec += (time_t)(timeout_ms / 1000);
            ts.tv_nsec += (long)((timeout_ms % 1000) * 1000000L);
            if (ts.tv_nsec >= 1000000000L) {
                ts.tv_sec++;
                ts.tv_nsec -= 1000000000L;
            }

            if (pthread_cond_timedwait(&queue->not_empty, &queue->lock, &ts) != 0) {
                pthread_mutex_unlock(&queue->lock);
                return ERROR;
            }
        }
    }

    *msg = queue->items[queue->head];
    queue->head = (queue->head + 1) % AGENT_BUS_QUEUE_LEN;
    queue->count--;

    pthread_cond_signal(&queue->not_full);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&queue->lock);
    return OK;
}

/* -- Public Functions ----------------------------------------------------- */

void message_bus_msg_free(agent_msg_t *msg)
{
    if (msg == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    if (msg->content != NULL) {
        free(msg->content);
        msg->content = NULL;
    }

    if (msg->image_b64 != NULL) {
        free(msg->image_b64);
        msg->image_b64 = NULL;
    }
}

int message_bus_init(void)
{
    if (g_initialized) {
        return OK;
    }

    msg_queue_init(&g_inbound_queue);
    msg_queue_init(&g_outbound_queue);
    g_bus_shutdown = false;
    g_initialized = true;

    syslog(LOG_INFO, "[%s] Message bus initialized (depth %d)\n",
           TAG, AGENT_BUS_QUEUE_LEN);
    return OK;
}

void message_bus_destroy(void)
{
    if (!g_initialized) {
        return;
    }

    msg_queue_destroy(&g_inbound_queue);
    msg_queue_destroy(&g_outbound_queue);
    g_initialized = false;

    syslog(LOG_INFO, "[%s] Message bus destroyed\n", TAG);
}

void message_bus_wakeup(void)
{
    g_bus_shutdown = true;

    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_inbound_queue.lock);
    pthread_cond_broadcast(&g_inbound_queue.not_empty);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_inbound_queue.lock);

    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_outbound_queue.lock);
    pthread_cond_broadcast(&g_outbound_queue.not_empty);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_outbound_queue.lock);
}

int message_bus_push_inbound(const agent_msg_t *msg)
{
    if (msg == NULL) {
        return ERROR;
    }

    return msg_queue_push(&g_inbound_queue, msg, AGENT_BUS_PUSH_TIMEOUT_MS);
}

int message_bus_pop_inbound(agent_msg_t *msg, uint32_t timeout_ms)
{
    if (msg == NULL) {
        return ERROR;
    }

    return msg_queue_pop(&g_inbound_queue, msg, timeout_ms);
}

int message_bus_push_outbound(const agent_msg_t *msg)
{
    if (msg == NULL) {
        return ERROR;
    }

    return msg_queue_push(&g_outbound_queue, msg, AGENT_BUS_PUSH_TIMEOUT_MS);
}

int message_bus_pop_outbound(agent_msg_t *msg, uint32_t timeout_ms)
{
    if (msg == NULL) {
        return ERROR;
    }

    return msg_queue_pop(&g_outbound_queue, msg, timeout_ms);
}


# 6. Reuse ai_agent message_bus instead of implementing the LLM again

The contest implementation of `voice_channel_start()` must eventually:

1. capture microphone PCM;
2. send PCM to MiMo ASR;
3. obtain text;
4. publish that text to ai_agent's existing inbound message bus.

Do not directly invoke MiMo LLM from contest unless absolutely necessary.

The message should use:

```c

chat_id = "voice"
content = recognized_text
```

Follow the ownership convention used by ai_agent:

```c
agent_msg_t msg = {0};

strncpy(msg.channel,
        AGENT_CHAN_VOICE,
        sizeof(msg.channel) - 1);

strncpy(msg.chat_id,
        "voice",
        sizeof(msg.chat_id) - 1);

msg.content = strdup(recognized_text);

if (msg.content != NULL)
{
    message_bus_push_inbound(&msg);
}
```

Do not free `msg.content` after a successful push unless the message_bus API documentation says otherwise.

This is important.

# 7. Why AGENT_CHAN_VOICE is important

The existing ai_agent agent loop will process the recognized text:

```text
MiMo ASR
→ message_bus_push_inbound()
→ agent_loop
→ LLM
→ tools
→ session/history
→ response
→ message_bus_push_outbound()
```

Then `agent_main` already performs:

```text
if channel == AGENT_CHAN_VOICE
    voice_channel_speak(msg.content)
```

Because our contest implementation owns the strong `voice_channel_speak()` symbol, the final path becomes:

```text
existing ai_agent LLM response
        ↓
existing outbound dispatcher
        ↓
contest voice_channel_speak()
        ↓
contest MiMo TTS
        ↓
contest speaker
```

This is exactly the integration we want.

Do NOT introduce a second outbound dispatcher.

Do NOT consume ai_agent outbound messages manually unless this ABI method proves impossible.

verify_built_voice_image()
{
  local elf="${NUTTX_DIR}/nuttx"

  # Skip artifact verification for maintenance targets.
  if printf '%s\n' "$@" | grep -Eq '(^|[[:space:]])(clean|distclean)([[:space:]]|$)'; then
    return 0
  fi

  if test ! -f "${elf}"; then
    echo "Post-build verification failed: missing ${elf}" >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  # The contest-local robot_voice application is independent of the
  # historical ai_agent streaming implementation.  When the legacy
  # voice_echo app is disabled, validate the new app marker and do not require
  # private symbols/strings from packages/ai_agent.
  if grep -Eq '^CONFIG_LVX_USE_DEMO_CONTEST2026_295_ROBOT_VOICE=y$' \
      "${NUTTX_DIR}/.config" && \
      ! grep -Eq '^CONFIG_LVX_USE_DEMO_CONTEST2026_295_VOICE_ECHO=y$' \
      "${NUTTX_DIR}/.config"; then
    if ! grep -aF 'robot_voice_main' "${elf}" >/dev/null; then
      echo "Post-build verification failed: ELF missing robot_voice marker" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    echo "Post-build verification: contest-local robot_voice linked"
    return 0
  fi

  local missing=0

  # Verify that the streaming TTS implementation and streaming HTTPS
  # transport actually reached the final firmware image.
  for marker in \
    'TTS streaming request' \
    'transport stream enter:'; do
    if ! strings "${elf}" | grep -Fq "${marker}"; then
      echo "Post-build verification failed: ELF missing streaming marker: ${marker}" >&2
      missing=1
    fi
  done

  # The old fixed-buffer diagnostics should not survive in the final image.
  # Their presence usually means an old mimo_voice object/archive was linked.
  for marker in \
    'TTS response bytes=' \
    'TTS audio base64 bytes=' \
    'TTS WAV bytes=' \
    'TTS PCM output too small'; do
    if strings "${elf}" | grep -Fq "${marker}"; then
      echo "Post-build verification failed: ELF still contains legacy TTS marker: ${marker}" >&2
      missing=1
    fi

## 编译流程

1. 用户指定或确认目标配置路径
2. 执行 `./build.sh <path> --cmake -j$(nproc)`
3. 检查输出最后几行是否包含 `build completed successfully`
4. 如果编译失败，分析错误日志并尝试修复（最多 3 轮）

## 编译失败处理

| 错误类型 | 特征 | 处理 |
|----------|------|------|
| 代码错误 | `error:` + 本驱动文件名 | 自动修复代码，重新编译 |
| 配置缺失 | `undefined reference` + CONFIG 相关 | 提示用户 menuconfig 开启 |
| 工具链问题 | `command not found` | 提示用户安装工具链 |
| 缓存问题 | 奇怪的链接错误 | `rm -rf <OUTPUT_DIR>` 后重编 |

如果需要临时启用某个 CONFIG 进行编译验证：

修改后重新编译即可。

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# Build the contest ESP32-S3 board with a temporary, reversible
# esp-hal-3rdparty lock-initializer backport.
#
# Fresh workspaces may not contain esp-hal-3rdparty yet. NuttX prepares it
# during the normal build context phase, so this wrapper bootstraps that
# phase first when needed, then applies the local backport and performs the
# real build.

set -euo pipefail

readonly SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
readonly OPENVELA_ROOT="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/../../../.." && pwd)"
readonly CONFIG_PATH="vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_295_board/configs/nsh"
readonly HAL_PATCH_TOOL="${SCRIPT_DIR}/esp_hal_lock_backport.sh"
readonly NUTTX_BREAK_PATCH_TOOL="${SCRIPT_DIR}/nuttx_xtensa_break_backport.sh"
readonly NUTTX_RAW_EXC_PATCH_TOOL="${SCRIPT_DIR}/nuttx_xtensa_raw_exception_backport.sh"
readonly NUTTX_RAW_EXC="${NUTTX_RAW_EXC:-0}"
readonly AI_AGENT_PATCH_TOOL="${SCRIPT_DIR}/ai_agent_esp32s3_backport.sh"  # compatibility-only; never modifies packages/ai_agent
readonly MYENV_DIR="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/myenv"
readonly BUILD_SH="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/build.sh"
readonly NUTTX_DIR="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/nuttx"
readonly HAL_DIR="${NUTTX_DIR}/arch/xtensa/src/esp32s3/esp-hal-3rdparty"

readonly VOICE_FIX_REQUIRED="${VOICE_FIX_REQUIRED:-0}"
readonly VOICE_TLS_SRC="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/packages/ai_agent/src/infra/vela_tls.c"
readonly VOICE_MIMO_SRC="${OPENVELA_ROOT}/packages/ai_agent/src/voice/mimo_voice.c"

cd "${OPENVELA_ROOT}"

if test ! -x "${MYENV_DIR}/bin/python"; then
  echo "Creating Python virtual environment: ${MYENV_DIR}"
  python3 -m venv "${MYENV_DIR}"
fi

# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source "${MYENV_DIR}/bin/activate"

# Keep the board-local esptool wrapper ahead of the system PATH.
export PATH="${SCRIPT_DIR}:${PATH}"

hal_checkout_ready()
{
  git -C "${HAL_DIR}" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1
}

reset_generated_build_state()
{
  rm -f "${NUTTX_DIR}/.config" \
        "${NUTTX_DIR}/Make.defs" \
        "${NUTTX_DIR}/staging/libarch.a" \
        "${NUTTX_DIR}/staging/libboard.a"
}

bootstrap_hal_checkout()
{
  if hal_checkout_ready; then
    return 0
  fi

  echo "HAL checkout is missing:"
  echo "  ${HAL_DIR}"
  echo
  echo "Bootstrapping the normal NuttX build context first..."

  reset_generated_build_state

  # Follow openvela's normal build path so NuttX creates/clones the ESP HAL
  # checkout using the revision expected by this NuttX tree.
  if ! "${BUILD_SH}" "${CONFIG_PATH}" context; then
    echo "HAL bootstrap via build.sh context failed." >&2
    echo "Expected HAL checkout:" >&2
    echo "  ${HAL_DIR}" >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  if ! hal_checkout_ready; then
    echo "build.sh context completed, but the HAL checkout was not created." >&2
    echo "Expected:" >&2
    echo "  ${HAL_DIR}" >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  echo "HAL checkout bootstrapped successfully."
  echo "HAL HEAD: $(git -C "${HAL_DIR}" rev-parse HEAD)"
}

refresh_demo_kconfig()

    cd "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/packages/demos"

prepare_build_context()

  "${BUILD_SH}" "${CONFIG_PATH}" context

verify_voice_fix_sources()
{
  if test "${VOICE_FIX_REQUIRED}" != 1; then
    echo "Voice source policy verification: SKIPPED; local packages/ai_agent source is authoritative (VOICE_FIX_REQUIRED=${VOICE_FIX_REQUIRED})"
    return 0
  fi

  test -f "${VOICE_TLS_SRC}" || {
    echo "Missing voice TLS source: ${VOICE_TLS_SRC}" >&2
    exit 1
  }

  test -f "${VOICE_MIMO_SRC}" || {
    echo "Missing MiMo voice source: ${VOICE_MIMO_SRC}" >&2
    exit 1
  }

  local missing=0

  for marker in \
    'DNS start:' \
    'TCP connect start:' \
    'upload progress:'; do
    if ! grep -Fq "${marker}" "${VOICE_TLS_SRC}"; then
      echo "Voice fix marker missing from vela_tls.c: ${marker}" >&2
      missing=1
    fi
  done

  # The build wrapper must verify capability, not dictate runtime key policy.
  # Accept either lookup order as long as both the generic fallback and the
  # MiMo-specific key path still exist in get_api_key().
  local key_block
  key_block="$(
    sed -n '/static int get_api_key/,/^}/p' "${VOICE_MIMO_SRC}"
  )"

  if ! grep -Fq 'AGENT_CFG_KEY_MIMO_API_KEY' <<<"${key_block}"; then
    echo "MiMo voice key support is missing in mimo_voice.c" >&2
    missing=1
  fi

  if ! grep -Fq 'AGENT_CFG_KEY_API_KEY' <<<"${key_block}"; then
    echo "Generic API key fallback is missing in mimo_voice.c" >&2
    missing=1
  fi

  local first_key
  first_key="$(
    grep -Eo 'AGENT_CFG_KEY_(MIMO_API_KEY|API_KEY)' <<<"${key_block}" |
      head -n 1 || true
  )"

  if test "${first_key}" != "AGENT_CFG_KEY_MIMO_API_KEY"; then
    echo "Voice fix source verification: NOTE - get_api_key() checks ${first_key:-no-key} first; build allowed."
  fi

  # The current MiMo TTS path must use incremental HTTP/Base64/WAV
  # processing and feed PCM through the voice streaming callback.  Do not
  # require the old whole-response TTS markers here: those belong to the
  # retired fixed-buffer implementation.
  for marker in \
    'TTS streaming request' \
    'mimo_tts_stream_synthesize' \
    '.stream_synthesize = mimo_tts_stream_synthesize'; do
    if ! grep -Fq "${marker}" "${VOICE_MIMO_SRC}"; then
      echo "Streaming TTS marker missing from mimo_voice.c: ${marker}" >&2
      missing=1
    fi
  done

  # Streaming TTS depends on the incremental HTTPS response path in vela_tls.
  for marker in \
    'vela_https_post_json_stream' \
    'transport stream enter:'; do
    if ! grep -Fq "${marker}" "${VOICE_TLS_SRC}"; then
      echo "Streaming HTTPS marker missing from vela_tls.c: ${marker}" >&2
      missing=1
    fi
  done

  if test "${missing}" != 0; then
    echo "Refusing to build: expected voice-chain fixes are not present." >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  echo "Voice fix source verification: OK"
}

      -name 'voice_channel.c.*.o' -o \
      -name 'voice_tts.c.*.o' -o \
      -name 'voice_asr.c.*.o' \
    \) -print -delete 2>/dev/null || true

  # vela_tls.c also lives outside nuttx/ and can leave an external object
  # behind.  Remove it as well so the streaming transport implementation
  # cannot be shadowed by a stale object.
  find "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/packages/ai_agent/src/infra" \
    -maxdepth 1 -type f \
    -name 'vela_tls.c.*.o' \
    -name 'vela_tls.c.*.o' \
    -print -delete 2>/dev/null || true

  rm -f \
    "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/apps/libapps.a" \
    "${NUTTX_DIR}/staging/libapps.a"

  echo "Forcing clean rebuild so the current local ai_agent sources are compiled exactly as present..."
  make -C "${NUTTX_DIR}" clean
}


verify_built_voice_image()
{
  local elf="${NUTTX_DIR}/nuttx"

  # Skip artifact verification for maintenance targets.
  if printf '%s
' "$@" | grep -Eq '(^|[[:space:]])(clean|distclean)([[:space:]]|$)'; then
    return 0
  fi

  if test ! -f "${elf}"; then
    echo "Post-build verification failed: missing ${elf}" >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  # The contest-local robot_voice application is independent of the
  # historical ai_agent streaming implementation.  When the legacy
  # voice_echo app is disabled, validate the new app marker and do not require
  # private symbols/strings from packages/ai_agent.
  if grep -Eq '^CONFIG_LVX_USE_DEMO_CONTEST2026_295_ROBOT_VOICE=y$' \
      "${NUTTX_DIR}/.config" && \
      ! grep -Eq '^CONFIG_LVX_USE_DEMO_CONTEST2026_295_VOICE_ECHO=y$' \
      "${NUTTX_DIR}/.config"; then
    if ! grep -aF 'robot_voice_main' "${elf}" >/dev/null; then
      echo "Post-build verification failed: ELF missing robot_voice marker" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    echo "Post-build verification: contest-local robot_voice linked"
    return 0
  fi

  local missing=0

  # Verify that the streaming TTS implementation and streaming HTTPS
  # transport actually reached the final firmware image.
  for marker in \
    'TTS streaming request' \
    'transport stream enter:'; do
    if ! strings "${elf}" | grep -Fq "${marker}"; then
      echo "Post-build verification failed: ELF missing streaming marker: ${marker}" >&2
      missing=1
    fi
  done

  # The old fixed-buffer diagnostics should not survive in the final image.
  # Their presence usually means an old mimo_voice object/archive was linked.
  for marker in \
    'TTS response bytes=' \
    'TTS audio base64 bytes=' \
    'TTS WAV bytes=' \
    'TTS PCM output too small'; do
    if strings "${elf}" | grep -Fq "${marker}"; then
      echo "Post-build verification failed: ELF still contains legacy TTS marker: ${marker}" >&2
      missing=1
    fi
  done

  if test "${missing}" != 0; then
    echo "The firmware was built, but the streaming MiMo TTS/HTTPS sources were not linked cleanly into nuttx." >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  echo "Post-build streaming voice verification: OK"
}

hal_rollback=0
nuttx_break_rollback=0
nuttx_raw_exc_rollback=0
ai_agent_rollback=0

restore_backports()
{
  local rc=$?

  trap - EXIT INT TERM

  if test "${ai_agent_rollback}" = 1; then
    if ! "${AI_AGENT_PATCH_TOOL}" restore; then
      echo "failed to restore temporary ai_agent build compatibility files" >&2
      if test "${rc}" -eq 0; then
        rc=1
      fi
    fi
  fi

  if test "${nuttx_break_rollback}" = 1; then
    if ! "${NUTTX_BREAK_PATCH_TOOL}" reverse; then
      echo "failed to restore the NuttX Xtensa BREAK backport" >&2
      if test "${rc}" -eq 0; then
        rc=1
      fi
    fi
  fi

  if test "${nuttx_raw_exc_rollback}" = 1; then
    if ! "${NUTTX_RAW_EXC_PATCH_TOOL}" reverse; then
      echo "failed to restore the raw Xtensa exception diagnostic" >&2
      if test "${rc}" -eq 0; then
        rc=1
      fi
    fi
  fi

  if test "${hal_rollback}" = 1; then
    if ! "${HAL_PATCH_TOOL}" reverse; then
      echo "failed to restore the HAL backport" >&2
      if test "${rc}" -eq 0; then
        rc=1
      fi
    fi
  fi

  exit "${rc}"
}

```text
    robot_voice_compat.c

```

# 11. MiMo ASR requirements

Microphone source format should remain the already-proven capture format:

```text
PCM signed 16-bit little-endian
16000 Hz
1 channel
mono
```

Pipeline:

```text
I2S0 / microphone
→ PCM
→ optional WAV header
→ MiMo ASR request
→ JSON response
→ recognized UTF-8 text
```

Reuse the working microphone/DMA implementation from contest `voice_echo`.

Do not use media_recorder unless it is known to work on this board.

Prefer the already verified contest I2S capture path.

Reference implementation sources:

```text
contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/voice_echo/voice_echo_main.c
contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/src/contest_i2s.c
```

---

# 12. MiMo TTS requirements

The known returned format is:

```text
codec: pcm_s16le
sample rate: 24000 Hz
channels: 1
bits per sample: 16
```

Therefore the TTS parser must output exactly:

```text
24000 Hz
mono
signed 16-bit little-endian PCM
```

Do not resample unless the hardware side actually requires it.

Do not reinterpret PCM as 8-bit or 32-bit.

Do not swap byte order.

The HTTP response path is:

```text
HTTP stream
→ JSON
→ audio.data
→ Base64 decode
→ WAV
→ data chunk
→ PCM s16le
```

Keep WAV parsing independent of HTTP chunk boundaries.

A WAV header may be fragmented across HTTP callbacks.

A Base64 quantum may also be fragmented across callbacks.

Both parsers must therefore be incremental.

---

```bash

grep -Rni \
'vela_https_post_json_stream\|vela_https_post_json\|vela_https_get' \
packages/ai_agent/src/infra
```

If the restored package exposes everything required by MiMo ASR/TTS, call those APIs from contest.

That is preferred.

If the restored package does NOT expose streaming POST support, DO NOT modify `vela_tls.c`.

Instead create:

```text
contest_mimo_http.c
```

in contest and copy only the necessary streaming transport logic from:

```text
packages_修改/ai_agent/src/infra/vela_tls.c
```

The contest HTTPS implementation may use mbedTLS directly.

Do not copy unrelated:

```text
connection pool

proxy

OpenAI LLM logic
```

Only implement what MiMo ASR/TTS requires.

# 14. Playback implementation

Do not return to the original direct:

```text
HTTP callback
→ I2S_SEND()
```

architecture.

The working architecture must remain:

```text
TTS HTTP callback
        ↓
PCM producer
        ↓
ring buffer
        ↓
playback worker
        ↓
I2S submission
        ↓
DMA
```

Network reception and DMA submission must be decoupled.

Keep:

```text
producer = TTS parser
consumer = playback worker
```

Never submit DMA directly from the TLS/network callback.

---

# 15. Playback state machine

Use a state machine:

```text
IDLE
PREBUFFER
PLAYING
REBUFFER
DRAINING
STOPPED
ERROR
```

Expected transition:

```text
IDLE
→ PREBUFFER
→ PLAYING
→ DRAINING
→ IDLE
```

On starvation:

```text
PLAYING
→ REBUFFER
→ PLAYING
```

Important:

Do not duplicate or replay old PCM when underrun occurs.

If there is insufficient PCM:

```text
pause submission
wait for buffer refill
resume from current read pointer
```

Never rewind the ring buffer.

That was one of the likely causes of the previous double-voice / echo / dragging sound.

---

# 16. Start with the known-good audio version

The previous fully buffered implementation produced correct audio at the cost of latency.

Therefore use it as the correctness baseline.

Copy the final known-good playback logic from:

```text
playback worker
APB lifecycle
I2S_SEND
completion callback
prebuffer
drain
stop
```

First reproduce correct audio.

Only after correctness is reproduced optimize latency.

Correctness before latency.

---

# 17. Latency optimization must be incremental

Do not jump directly from full buffering to very small buffers.

Known TTS format:

```text
24000 samples/s
2 bytes/sample
= 48000 bytes/s
```

Therefore:

```text
2048 bytes ≈ 42.7 ms
8192 bytes ≈ 170 ms
16384 bytes ≈ 341 ms
32768 bytes ≈ 683 ms
```

Start with:

```text
ring buffer: 128 KB or 256 KB
initial prebuffer: 32 KB
rebuffer threshold: 16 KB
DMA payload: known-good block size
```

If stable, test:

```text
initial prebuffer: 24 KB
```

then:

```text
16 KB
```

Never change simultaneously:

```text
I2S slot format
DMA size
sample rate
ring buffer
prebuffer
HTTP parser
```

Change one variable at a time.

---

# 18. I2S wire format must be verified independently

The MiMo source PCM is mono.

MAX98357 / ESP32-S3 I2S may require a stereo-slot wire stream depending on current contest I2S configuration.

Do not infer from the audio file alone.

Compare the implementation that produced the known-good final sentence.

Inspect:

```text
contest_i2s_tx_set_format()
contest_i2s_tx_set_channels()
contest_i2s_tx_set_rate()
```

Determine:

```text
sample rate
bits/sample
slot width
slot count
left/right slot enable
mono duplication behavior
DMA byte interpretation
```

The logical source format and physical wire format are separate concepts.

Example:

```text
source:
24kHz / mono / 16-bit

wire:
24k frame rate / stereo slots / 16-bit
```

may be correct.

If stereo duplication is required:

```text
sample n
→ L = sample n
→ R = sample n
```

But do not duplicate unless the I2S configuration proves that two slots are consumed.

For every `I2S_SEND()`:

```text
allocate APB
fill APB
submit
DO NOT free
```

Only the completion callback owns final release.

The playback worker may track:

```text
inflight
pending
queued bytes
completion count
```

but must never reuse an APB before the DMA completion callback.

Add assertions/logging around:

```c
    while active:

        run MiMo ASR;

```

But do not block the Vela CLI thread indefinitely.


`voice_channel_stop()` should signal and join/stop the voice worker safely.

# 21. voice_channel_speak behavior

`voice_channel_speak(text)` is called from ai_agent's outbound dispatcher.

It should:

```text
text
→ MiMo TTS
→ PCM ring buffer
→ playback worker
→ wait until this utterance finishes
→ return
```

Do not feed the resulting speaker audio back into ASR.

The recording worker should be paused/muted while TTS is playing.

Use a global voice state such as:

```text
LISTENING
THINKING
SPEAKING
```

During:

```text
SPEAKING
```

microphone ASR submission should be disabled.

After playback is completely drained:

```text
SPEAKING
→ LISTENING
```

This prevents robot self-echo.

Use a single voice context:

```c
struct contest_voice_ctx
{

    bool stopping;
    bool speaking;

    ASR backend;

    PCM ring;
    playback worker;

    microphone worker;
};
```

Do not keep independent duplicated global states in each source file.

There must only be one playback owner.

There must only be one active speaker I2S session.

There must only be one microphone recording owner.

# 12. MiMo TTS requirements

The known returned format is:

```text
codec: pcm_s16le
sample rate: 24000 Hz
channels: 1
bits per sample: 16
```

Therefore the TTS parser must output exactly:

```text
24000 Hz
mono
signed 16-bit little-endian PCM
```

Do not resample unless the hardware side actually requires it.

Do not reinterpret PCM as 8-bit or 32-bit.

Do not swap byte order.

The HTTP response path is:

```text
HTTP stream
→ JSON
→ audio.data
→ Base64 decode
→ WAV
→ data chunk
→ PCM s16le
```

Keep WAV parsing independent of HTTP chunk boundaries.

A WAV header may be fragmented across HTTP callbacks.

A Base64 quantum may also be fragmented across callbacks.

Both parsers must therefore be incremental.

```text

        ↓
PCM producer

ring buffer
        ↓
playback worker
        ↓
I2S submission
        ↓
DMA
```

Network reception and DMA submission must be decoupled.

Keep:

```text
producer = TTS parser
consumer = playback worker
```

Never submit DMA directly from the TLS/network callback.

---

# 15. Playback state machine

Use a state machine:

```text
IDLE
PREBUFFER
PLAYING
REBUFFER
DRAINING
STOPPED
ERROR
```

Expected transition:

```text
IDLE
→ PREBUFFER
→ PLAYING
→ DRAINING
→ IDLE
```

On starvation:

```text
PLAYING
→ REBUFFER
→ PLAYING
```

Important:

Do not duplicate or replay old PCM when underrun occurs.

If there is insufficient PCM:

```text
pause submission
wait for buffer refill
resume from current read pointer
```

Never rewind the ring buffer.

That was one of the likely causes of the previous double-voice / echo / dragging sound.

# 17. Latency optimization must be incremental

Do not jump directly from full buffering to very small buffers.

Known TTS format:

```text
24000 samples/s
2 bytes/sample
= 48000 bytes/s
```

Therefore:

```text
2048 bytes ≈ 42.7 ms
8192 bytes ≈ 170 ms
16384 bytes ≈ 341 ms
32768 bytes ≈ 683 ms
```

Start with:

```text
ring buffer: 128 KB or 256 KB
initial prebuffer: 32 KB
rebuffer threshold: 16 KB
DMA payload: known-good block size
```

If stable, test:

```text
initial prebuffer: 24 KB
```

then:

```text
16 KB
```

Never change simultaneously:

```text
I2S slot format
DMA size
sample rate
ring buffer
prebuffer
HTTP parser
```

Change one variable at a time.

# openvela Build

编译 openvela 固件、修改内核配置、运行模拟器。

## 默认目标

默认编译目标为 goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap（64 位 ARM 模拟器）：

```
CONFIG_PATH=vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/
OUTPUT_DIR=cmake_out/vela_goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/
```

如果用户指定了其他板级配置路径，替换上述路径即可。

## 命令

### 编译

```bash
./build.sh <CONFIG_PATH> --cmake -j$(nproc)
```

示例：
```bash
./build.sh vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/ --cmake -j$(nproc)
```

**成功标志**: 输出 `#### build completed successfully`

**编译产物**: `<OUTPUT_DIR>/nuttx`（ELF）、`<OUTPUT_DIR>/vela_ap.bin`

### 修改内核配置（menuconfig）

```bash
./build.sh <CONFIG_PATH> --cmake menuconfig
```

menuconfig 是交互式 TUI 界面，**不能在 AI 终端中直接运行**。提示用户在自己的终端中执行。

修改配置后保存会自动更新 `.config`。如需持久化到 defconfig：
```bash
./build.sh <CONFIG_PATH> --cmake savedefconfig
```

### 运行模拟器

```bash
./emulator.sh <OUTPUT_DIR>
```

示例：
```bash
./emulator.sh cmake_out/vela_goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/
```

**成功标志**: 出现 `goldfish-armv8a-ap>` NSH 提示符

### 清理编译

```bash
rm -rf <OUTPUT_DIR>
```

全量清理后重新编译：
```bash
rm -rf cmake_out/vela_goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/ && ./build.sh vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/ --cmake -j$(nproc)
```

## 编译流程

1. 用户指定或确认目标配置路径
2. 执行 `./build.sh <path> --cmake -j$(nproc)`
3. 检查输出最后几行是否包含 `build completed successfully`
4. 如果编译失败，分析错误日志并尝试修复（最多 3 轮）

## 编译失败处理

| 错误类型 | 特征 | 处理 |
|----------|------|------|
| 代码错误 | `error:` + 本驱动文件名 | 自动修复代码，重新编译 |
| 配置缺失 | `undefined reference` + CONFIG 相关 | 提示用户 menuconfig 开启 |
| 工具链问题 | `command not found` | 提示用户安装工具链 |
| 缓存问题 | 奇怪的链接错误 | `rm -rf <OUTPUT_DIR>` 后重编 |

## 启用新驱动的 CONFIG

如果需要临时启用某个 CONFIG 进行编译验证：

```bash
# 方法 1: 直接追加到 defconfig（推荐）
echo "CONFIG_SENSORS_BME680=y" >> <CONFIG_PATH>/defconfig

# 方法 2: 用 sed 修改 .config（临时，不持久化）
sed -i 's/# CONFIG_SENSORS_BME680 is not set/CONFIG_SENSORS_BME680=y/' <OUTPUT_DIR>/.config
```

修改后重新编译即可。

## 常用配置路径

| 目标 | 配置路径 |
|------|----------|
| goldfish-arm64 (推荐) | `vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/` |
| goldfish-arm32 | `vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-armeabi-v7a-ap/` |
| 自定义板级 | `vendor/<vendor>/boards/<chip>/<board>/configs/<config>/` |

3. 明确 ownership

实现严格 ownership：

voice_channel_start()
只负责：

- 创建 session
- 设置 stop_requested=false
- 创建 voice worker

voice worker 唯一拥有：

- capture session
- APB
- capture semaphore
- I2S capture lifecycle
- MiMo ASR call

voice_channel_stop()
只能：

stop_requested=true
signal/wakeup worker

不得直接：

free APB
destroy semaphore
free session
destroy worker context

这些资源必须由 voice worker 自己退出时释放。

最终生命周期：

voice_start
    |
    v
voice worker
    |
    +-- capture
    |
    +-- ASR
    |
    +-- message_bus
    |
    +-- next capture
    |
stop_requested
    |
    v
worker cleanup
    |
    +-- stop I2S
    +-- release APB
    +-- destroy sem
    +-- running=false
    +-- exit

==================================================
4. 修复 outstanding I2S callback race
==================================================

重点注意：

I2S_RECEIVE 是 asynchronous。

因此不能：

I2S_RECEIVE(...)
free(apb)

也不能：

I2S_RECEIVE(...)
voice_stop()
sem_destroy()
free(context)

必须保证最后一个 RX callback 已完成后才释放。

建议 capture context 增加：

volatile bool stopping;
volatile bool callback_pending;

或者 inflight counter。

提交前：

inflight++

callback：

inflight--
sem_post(...)

shutdown：

stopping = true
停止提交新的 I2S_RECEIVE

然后等待：

inflight == 0

最后才：

free APB
destroy sem
release capture state

不要 busy-spin；
使用 semaphore / sleep / condition mechanism。

==================================================
5. voice_stop 应为 graceful stop

voice_stop 后不要立即销毁。

例如：

voice_channel_stop()
{
    stop_requested = true;
    wake worker;
    return 0;
}

如果需要同步等待：

必须等 worker exited 标志。

不要 pthread_cancel capture worker。

不要从 CLI thread 释放 worker 私有资源。

# openvela Build

编译 openvela 固件、修改内核配置、运行模拟器。

## 默认目标

默认编译目标为 goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap（64 位 ARM 模拟器）：

```
CONFIG_PATH=vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/
OUTPUT_DIR=cmake_out/vela_goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/
```

如果用户指定了其他板级配置路径，替换上述路径即可。

## 命令

### 编译

```bash
./build.sh <CONFIG_PATH> --cmake -j$(nproc)
```

示例：
```bash
./build.sh vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/ --cmake -j$(nproc)
```

**成功标志**: 输出 `#### build completed successfully`

**编译产物**: `<OUTPUT_DIR>/nuttx`（ELF）、`<OUTPUT_DIR>/vela_ap.bin`

### 修改内核配置（menuconfig）

```bash
./build.sh <CONFIG_PATH> --cmake menuconfig
```

menuconfig 是交互式 TUI 界面，**不能在 AI 终端中直接运行**。提示用户在自己的终端中执行。

修改配置后保存会自动更新 `.config`。如需持久化到 defconfig：
```bash
./build.sh <CONFIG_PATH> --cmake savedefconfig
```

### 运行模拟器

```bash
./emulator.sh <OUTPUT_DIR>
```

示例：
```bash
./emulator.sh cmake_out/vela_goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/
```

**成功标志**: 出现 `goldfish-armv8a-ap>` NSH 提示符

### 清理编译

```bash
rm -rf <OUTPUT_DIR>
```

全量清理后重新编译：
```bash
rm -rf cmake_out/vela_goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/ && ./build.sh vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/ --cmake -j$(nproc)
```

## 编译流程

1. 用户指定或确认目标配置路径
2. 执行 `./build.sh <path> --cmake -j$(nproc)`
3. 检查输出最后几行是否包含 `build completed successfully`
4. 如果编译失败，分析错误日志并尝试修复（最多 3 轮）

## 编译失败处理

| 错误类型 | 特征 | 处理 |
|----------|------|------|
| 代码错误 | `error:` + 本驱动文件名 | 自动修复代码，重新编译 |
| 配置缺失 | `undefined reference` + CONFIG 相关 | 提示用户 menuconfig 开启 |
| 工具链问题 | `command not found` | 提示用户安装工具链 |
| 缓存问题 | 奇怪的链接错误 | `rm -rf <OUTPUT_DIR>` 后重编 |

## 启用新驱动的 CONFIG

如果需要临时启用某个 CONFIG 进行编译验证：

```bash
# 方法 1: 直接追加到 defconfig（推荐）
echo "CONFIG_SENSORS_BME680=y" >> <CONFIG_PATH>/defconfig

# 方法 2: 用 sed 修改 .config（临时，不持久化）
sed -i 's/# CONFIG_SENSORS_BME680 is not set/CONFIG_SENSORS_BME680=y/' <OUTPUT_DIR>/.config
```

修改后重新编译即可。

## 常用配置路径

| 目标 | 配置路径 |
|------|----------|
| goldfish-arm64 (推荐) | `vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/` |
| goldfish-arm32 | `vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-armeabi-v7a-ap/` |
| 自定义板级 | `vendor/<vendor>/boards/<chip>/<board>/configs/<config>/` |

verify_voice_fix_sources()
{
  if test "${VOICE_FIX_REQUIRED}" != 1; then
    echo "Voice source policy verification: SKIPPED; local packages/ai_agent source is authoritative (VOICE_FIX_REQUIRED=${VOICE_FIX_REQUIRED})"
    return 0
  fi

  test -f "${VOICE_TLS_SRC}" || {
    echo "Missing voice TLS source: ${VOICE_TLS_SRC}" >&2
    exit 1
  }

  test -f "${VOICE_MIMO_SRC}" || {
    echo "Missing MiMo voice source: ${VOICE_MIMO_SRC}" >&2
    exit 1
  }

  local missing=0

  for marker in \
    'DNS start:' \
    'TCP connect start:' \
    'upload progress:'; do
    if ! grep -Fq "${marker}" "${VOICE_TLS_SRC}"; then
      echo "Voice fix marker missing from vela_tls.c: ${marker}" >&2
      missing=1
    fi
  done

  # The build wrapper must verify capability, not dictate runtime key policy.
  # Accept either lookup order as long as both the generic fallback and the
  # MiMo-specific key path still exist in get_api_key().
  local key_block
  key_block="$(
    sed -n '/static int get_api_key/,/^}/p' "${VOICE_MIMO_SRC}"
  )"

  if ! grep -Fq 'AGENT_CFG_KEY_MIMO_API_KEY' <<<"${key_block}"; then
    echo "MiMo voice key support is missing in mimo_voice.c" >&2
    missing=1
  fi

  if ! grep -Fq 'AGENT_CFG_KEY_API_KEY' <<<"${key_block}"; then
    echo "Generic API key fallback is missing in mimo_voice.c" >&2
    missing=1
  fi

  local first_key
  first_key="$(
    grep -Eo 'AGENT_CFG_KEY_(MIMO_API_KEY|API_KEY)' <<<"${key_block}" |
      head -n 1 || true
  )"

  if test "${first_key}" != "AGENT_CFG_KEY_MIMO_API_KEY"; then
    echo "Voice fix source verification: NOTE - get_api_key() checks ${first_key:-no-key} first; build allowed."
  fi

  # The current MiMo TTS path must use incremental HTTP/Base64/WAV
  # processing and feed PCM through the voice streaming callback.  Do not
  # require the old whole-response TTS markers here: those belong to the
  # retired fixed-buffer implementation.
  for marker in \
    'TTS streaming request' \
    'mimo_tts_stream_synthesize' \
    '.stream_synthesize = mimo_tts_stream_synthesize'; do
    if ! grep -Fq "${marker}" "${VOICE_MIMO_SRC}"; then
      echo "Streaming TTS marker missing from mimo_voice.c: ${marker}" >&2
      missing=1
    fi
  done

  # Streaming TTS depends on the incremental HTTPS response path in vela_tls.
  for marker in \
    'vela_https_post_json_stream' \
    'transport stream enter:'; do
    if ! grep -Fq "${marker}" "${VOICE_TLS_SRC}"; then
      echo "Streaming HTTPS marker missing from vela_tls.c: ${marker}" >&2
      missing=1
    fi
  done

  if test "${missing}" != 0; then
    echo "Refusing to build: expected voice-chain fixes are not present." >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  echo "Voice fix source verification: OK"
}

force_clean_rebuild()
{
  # The ai_agent sources live outside nuttx/, and old externally-built object
  # files can survive a context refresh.  Remove only the known stale MiMo
  # objects and application archives; do not distclean and do not touch the
  # board defconfig.

  find "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/packages/ai_agent/src/voice" \
    -maxdepth 1 -type f \( \
      -name 'mimo_voice.c.*.o' -o \
      -name 'audio_playback.c.*.o' -o \

      -name 'voice_tts.c.*.o' -o \
      -name 'voice_asr.c.*.o' \

    "${OPENVELA_ROOT}/apps/libapps.a" \
    "${NUTTX_DIR}/staging/libapps.a"

  echo "Forcing clean rebuild so the current local ai_agent sources are compiled exactly as present..."
  make -C "${NUTTX_DIR}" clean
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# ESP32-S3 ai_agent build compatibility helper.
#
# IMPORTANT POLICY:
#   packages/ai_agent is USER-OWNED SOURCE and is NEVER modified here.
#   This script does NOT git apply/reverse/checkout/reset/restore anything
#   under packages/ai_agent.
#
# The only temporary changes made by this helper are:
#   1. apps/crypto/mbedtls/Make.defs:
#        ${INCDIR_PREFIX} -> -isystem for the two mbedTLS include paths
#   2. HAL mbedtls_config.h:
#        disable MBEDTLS_CCM_C for this compatibility build
#
# Interface kept compatible with build_with_hal_backport.sh:
#   apply | restore | status

set -euo pipefail

readonly SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
readonly ROOT_DIR="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/../../../.." && pwd)"
readonly AGENT_DIR="${ROOT_DIR}/packages/ai_agent"
readonly HAL_DIR="${ROOT_DIR}/nuttx/arch/xtensa/src/esp32s3/esp-hal-3rdparty"
readonly MAKEDEFS="${ROOT_DIR}/apps/crypto/mbedtls/Make.defs"
readonly MBEDTLS_CFG="${HAL_DIR}/components/mbedtls/mbedtls/include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h"

readonly STATE_DIR="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/openvela-contest-ai-agent-compat"
readonly MARKER="${STATE_DIR}/root"
readonly MAKEDEFS_BACKUP="${STATE_DIR}/make.defs"
readonly MBEDTLS_BACKUP="${STATE_DIR}/mbedtls_config.h"
readonly MAKEDEFS_PATCHED_HASH="${STATE_DIR}/make.defs.patched.sha256"
readonly MBEDTLS_PATCHED_HASH="${STATE_DIR}/mbedtls_config.h.patched.sha256"

die()
{
  echo "ai_agent compatibility: $*" >&2
  exit 1
}

file_hash()
{
  sha256sum "$1" | awk '{print $1}'
}

require_targets()
{
  test -d "${AGENT_DIR}" || die "missing ai_agent source directory: ${AGENT_DIR}"
  test -f "${MAKEDEFS}" || die "missing target: ${MAKEDEFS}"
  test -f "${MBEDTLS_CFG}" || die "missing target: ${MBEDTLS_CFG}"

  # Deliberately do not inspect or enforce any ai_agent source marker here.
  # Local ai_agent source is authoritative and must be compiled as-is.
}

state_matches_root()
{
  test -f "${MARKER}" && test "$(cat "${MARKER}")" = "${ROOT_DIR}"
}

clear_state()
{
  rm -f \
    "${MAKEDEFS_BACKUP}" \
    "${MBEDTLS_BACKUP}" \
    "${MAKEDEFS_PATCHED_HASH}" \
    "${MBEDTLS_PATCHED_HASH}" \
    "${MARKER}"
  rmdir "${STATE_DIR}" 2>/dev/null || true
}

makedefs_is_ready()
{
  grep -Fq '${INCDIR_PREFIX}$(APPDIR)/crypto/mbedtls/include' "${MAKEDEFS}" &&
  grep -Fq '${INCDIR_PREFIX}$(APPDIR)/crypto/mbedtls/mbedtls/include' "${MAKEDEFS}"
}

makedefs_is_applied()
{
  ! grep -Fq '${INCDIR_PREFIX}$(APPDIR)/crypto/mbedtls/include' "${MAKEDEFS}" &&
  ! grep -Fq '${INCDIR_PREFIX}$(APPDIR)/crypto/mbedtls/mbedtls/include' "${MAKEDEFS}" &&
  grep -Fq 'CFLAGS += -isystem $(APPDIR)/crypto/mbedtls/include' "${MAKEDEFS}" &&
  grep -Fq 'CFLAGS += -isystem $(APPDIR)/crypto/mbedtls/mbedtls/include' "${MAKEDEFS}"
}

mbedtls_is_ready()
{
  grep -Fqx '#define MBEDTLS_CCM_C' "${MBEDTLS_CFG}"
}

mbedtls_is_applied()
{
  grep -Fqx '/* #define MBEDTLS_CCM_C */' "${MBEDTLS_CFG}"
}

all_ready()
{
  makedefs_is_ready && mbedtls_is_ready
}

all_applied()
{
  makedefs_is_applied && mbedtls_is_applied
}

target_matches_backup_or_patched()
{
  local target="$1"
  local backup="$2"
  local patched_hash_file="$3"
  local current_hash

  test -f "${target}" || return 1
  test -f "${backup}" || return 1

  current_hash="$(file_hash "${target}")"

  if test "${current_hash}" = "$(file_hash "${backup}")"; then
    return 0
  fi

  if test -s "${patched_hash_file}" &&
     test "${current_hash}" = "$(cat "${patched_hash_file}")"; then
    return 0
  fi

  return 1
}

recover_stale_state()
{
  state_matches_root || return 1

  # Recovery is intentionally restricted to the two compatibility targets.
  # packages/ai_agent is NEVER restored or reverse-patched.
  target_matches_backup_or_patched \
    "${MAKEDEFS}" "${MAKEDEFS_BACKUP}" "${MAKEDEFS_PATCHED_HASH}" || return 1
  target_matches_backup_or_patched \
    "${MBEDTLS_CFG}" "${MBEDTLS_BACKUP}" "${MBEDTLS_PATCHED_HASH}" || return 1

  echo "ai_agent compatibility: clearing stale compatibility state; ai_agent source untouched" >&2

  # Put only compatibility targets back to their saved originals.
  cp -p "${MAKEDEFS_BACKUP}" "${MAKEDEFS}"
  cp -p "${MBEDTLS_BACKUP}" "${MBEDTLS_CFG}"
  clear_state
  return 0
}

apply_compat()
{
  require_targets

  if state_matches_root; then
    if all_applied; then
      echo "ALREADY_APPLIED"
      return 0
    fi

    if ! recover_stale_state; then
      die "saved compatibility state is inconsistent; refusing to overwrite unknown changes"
    fi
  fi

  if all_applied; then
    # Compatibility files are already in the desired build state.
    # No source operation is needed.
    echo "ALREADY_APPLIED"
    return 0
  fi

  all_ready || die "compatibility targets are partially modified; refusing unsafe apply"

  mkdir -p "${STATE_DIR}"
  printf '%s\n' "${ROOT_DIR}" > "${MARKER}"
  cp -p "${MAKEDEFS}" "${MAKEDEFS_BACKUP}"
  cp -p "${MBEDTLS_CFG}" "${MBEDTLS_BACKUP}"

  sed -i \
    's|CFLAGS += ${INCDIR_PREFIX}$(APPDIR)/crypto/mbedtls/include|CFLAGS += -isystem $(APPDIR)/crypto/mbedtls/include|g; s|CFLAGS += ${INCDIR_PREFIX}$(APPDIR)/crypto/mbedtls/mbedtls/include|CFLAGS += -isystem $(APPDIR)/crypto/mbedtls/mbedtls/include|g; s|CXXFLAGS += ${INCDIR_PREFIX}$(APPDIR)/crypto/mbedtls/include|CXXFLAGS += -isystem $(APPDIR)/crypto/mbedtls/include|g; s|CXXFLAGS += ${INCDIR_PREFIX}$(APPDIR)/crypto/mbedtls/mbedtls/include|CXXFLAGS += -isystem $(APPDIR)/crypto/mbedtls/mbedtls/include|g' \
    "${MAKEDEFS}"

  sed -i \
    's/^#define MBEDTLS_CCM_C$/\/\* #define MBEDTLS_CCM_C \*\//' \
    "${MBEDTLS_CFG}"

  if ! all_applied; then
    cp -p "${MAKEDEFS_BACKUP}" "${MAKEDEFS}"
    cp -p "${MBEDTLS_BACKUP}" "${MBEDTLS_CFG}"
    clear_state
    die "post-apply compatibility check failed"
  fi

  file_hash "${MAKEDEFS}" > "${MAKEDEFS_PATCHED_HASH}"
  file_hash "${MBEDTLS_CFG}" > "${MBEDTLS_PATCHED_HASH}"

  echo "ai_agent compatibility: local packages/ai_agent source preserved exactly as-is" >&2
  echo "APPLIED"
}

restore_compat()
{
  require_targets

  if ! state_matches_root; then
    # No state means there is nothing this invocation owns.
    # Never guess, and never touch ai_agent source.
    echo "REVERTED"
    return 0
  fi

  target_matches_backup_or_patched \
    "${MAKEDEFS}" "${MAKEDEFS_BACKUP}" "${MAKEDEFS_PATCHED_HASH}" ||
    die "${MAKEDEFS} changed after apply; refusing to overwrite it"

  target_matches_backup_or_patched \
    "${MBEDTLS_CFG}" "${MBEDTLS_BACKUP}" "${MBEDTLS_PATCHED_HASH}" ||
    die "${MBEDTLS_CFG} changed after apply; refusing to overwrite it"

  cp -p "${MAKEDEFS_BACKUP}" "${MAKEDEFS}"
  cp -p "${MBEDTLS_BACKUP}" "${MBEDTLS_CFG}"
  clear_state

  echo "ai_agent compatibility: restored compatibility files only; packages/ai_agent untouched" >&2
  echo "REVERTED"
}

status_compat()
{
  require_targets

  if state_matches_root; then
    if all_applied; then
      echo "APPLIED"
    else
      echo "DIRTY"
      return 1
    fi
  elif all_applied; then
    echo "ALREADY_APPLIED"
  elif all_ready; then
    echo "READY"
  else
    echo "DIRTY"
    return 1
  fi
}

case "${1:-}" in
  apply) apply_compat ;;
  restore) restore_compat ;;
  status) status_compat ;;
  *) echo "Usage: $0 {apply|restore|status}" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac

[robot_voice_capture.c](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/robot_voice/robot_voice_capture.c:23) 已按 `packages_修改/ai_agent/src/voice/audio_capture.c` 改为单飞 RX：

- `packages_修改`：任意时刻 1 个 `I2S_RECEIVE`；回调仅记录结果并 `sem_post`；应用持有 `apb_alloc()` 的引用，复制后才 `apb_free()`；停止时 `AUDIOIOC_STOP` 促使 pending callback 返回，随后才能销毁 semaphore。
- `voice_echo`：预提交 2 个 APB，但有独立的 `abandoned`/late-callback 所有权转移机制。
- 原 robot_voice：预提交 2 个 RX，却不是完整复刻 `voice_echo` 的 abandon 协议。
- 现在 robot_voice：每块独立 APB/xfer，`1024` logical bytes，2 块 warmup；收到停止、超时或错误时执行 `I2S_STOP -> 等待 callback -> apb_free -> destroy semaphore`。不会在 callback 仍可能执行时离开该 xfer 的栈作用域。

因此，这次主要消除了“active + pending RX 与停止取消并发”的差异。它是基于已验证参考实现的收敛，不是对 `rt_timer` panic 根因的无证断言。

# openvela Build

编译 openvela 固件、修改内核配置、运行模拟器。

## 默认目标

默认编译目标为 goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap（64 位 ARM 模拟器）：

```
CONFIG_PATH=vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/
OUTPUT_DIR=cmake_out/vela_goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/
```

如果用户指定了其他板级配置路径，替换上述路径即可。

## 命令

### 编译

```bash
./build.sh <CONFIG_PATH> --cmake -j$(nproc)
```

示例：
```bash
./build.sh vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/ --cmake -j$(nproc)
```

**成功标志**: 输出 `#### build completed successfully`

**编译产物**: `<OUTPUT_DIR>/nuttx`（ELF）、`<OUTPUT_DIR>/vela_ap.bin`

### 修改内核配置（menuconfig）

```bash
./build.sh <CONFIG_PATH> --cmake menuconfig
```

menuconfig 是交互式 TUI 界面，**不能在 AI 终端中直接运行**。提示用户在自己的终端中执行。

修改配置后保存会自动更新 `.config`。如需持久化到 defconfig：
```bash
./build.sh <CONFIG_PATH> --cmake savedefconfig
```

### 运行模拟器

```bash
./emulator.sh <OUTPUT_DIR>
```

示例：
```bash
./emulator.sh cmake_out/vela_goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/
```

**成功标志**: 出现 `goldfish-armv8a-ap>` NSH 提示符

### 清理编译

```bash
rm -rf <OUTPUT_DIR>
```

全量清理后重新编译：
```bash
rm -rf cmake_out/vela_goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/ && ./build.sh vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/ --cmake -j$(nproc)
```

## 编译流程

1. 用户指定或确认目标配置路径
2. 执行 `./build.sh <path> --cmake -j$(nproc)`
3. 检查输出最后几行是否包含 `build completed successfully`
4. 如果编译失败，分析错误日志并尝试修复（最多 3 轮）

## 编译失败处理

| 错误类型 | 特征 | 处理 |
|----------|------|------|
| 代码错误 | `error:` + 本驱动文件名 | 自动修复代码，重新编译 |
| 配置缺失 | `undefined reference` + CONFIG 相关 | 提示用户 menuconfig 开启 |
| 工具链问题 | `command not found` | 提示用户安装工具链 |
| 缓存问题 | 奇怪的链接错误 | `rm -rf <OUTPUT_DIR>` 后重编 |

## 启用新驱动的 CONFIG

如果需要临时启用某个 CONFIG 进行编译验证：

```bash
# 方法 1: 直接追加到 defconfig（推荐）
echo "CONFIG_SENSORS_BME680=y" >> <CONFIG_PATH>/defconfig

# 方法 2: 用 sed 修改 .config（临时，不持久化）
sed -i 's/# CONFIG_SENSORS_BME680 is not set/CONFIG_SENSORS_BME680=y/' <OUTPUT_DIR>/.config
```

修改后重新编译即可。

## 常用配置路径

| 目标 | 配置路径 |
|------|----------|
| goldfish-arm64 (推荐) | `vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/` |
| goldfish-arm32 | `vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-armeabi-v7a-ap/` |
| 自定义板级 | `vendor/<vendor>/boards/<chip>/<board>/configs/<config>/` |

    53	
    54	int ssd1306_sendbyte(FAR struct ssd1306_dev_s *priv, uint8_t regval)
    55	{
    56	  /* 8-bit data read sequence:
    57	   *
    58	   *  Start - I2C_Write_Address - SSD1306_Reg_Address - SSD1306_Write_Data
    59	   *  - STOP
    60	   */
    61	
    62	  struct i2c_msg_s msg;
    63	  uint8_t txbuffer[2];
    64	  int ret;
    65	
    66	#ifdef CONFIG_LCD_SSD1306_REGDEBUG
    67	  _err("-> 0x%02x\n", regval);
    68	#endif
    69	
    70	  /* Setup to the data to be transferred.  Two bytes:  The SSD1306 register
    71	   * address followed by one byte of data.
    72	   */
    73	
    74	  txbuffer[0]   = 0x00;
    75	  txbuffer[1]   = regval;
    76	
    77	  /* Setup 8-bit SSD1306 address write message */
    78	
    79	  msg.frequency = CONFIG_SSD1306_I2CFREQ;  /* I2C frequency */
    80	  msg.addr      = priv->addr;              /* 7-bit address */
    81	  msg.flags     = 0;                       /* Write transaction, beginning with START */
    82	  msg.buffer    = txbuffer;                /* Transfer from this address */
    83	  msg.length    = 2;                       /* Send two bytes following the address
    84	                                            * then STOP */
    85	
    86	  /* Perform the transfer */
    87	
    88	  ret = I2C_TRANSFER(priv->i2c, &msg, 1);
    89	  if (ret < 0)
    90	    {
    91	      lcderr("ERROR: I2C_TRANSFER failed: %d\n", ret);
    92	    }
    93	
    94	  return ret;
    95	}

   110	  int ret;

   112	  /* 8-bit data read sequence:

   115	   *  - STOP

   117

   121

   123	  msg[0].addr      = priv->addr;              /* 7-bit address */
   124	  msg[0].flags     = I2C_M_NOSTOP;            /* Write transaction, beginning with START */
   125	  msg[0].buffer    = &transfer_mode;          /* Transfer mode send */
   126	  msg[0].length    = 1;                       /* Send the one byte register address */
   127	
   128	  /* Followed by the SSD1306 write data (with no RESTART, then STOP) */
   129

   131	  msg[1].addr      = priv->addr;              /* 7-bit address */
   132	  msg[1].flags     = I2C_M_NOSTART;           /* Write transaction with no RESTART */
   133	  msg[1].buffer    = data;                    /* Transfer from this address */
   134	  msg[1].length    = len;                     /* Send the data, then STOP */
   135	
   136	  ret = I2C_TRANSFER(priv->i2c, msg, 2);

### 1. 板级初始化

[board_oled.c](/home/foam/vela/openvela/vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_295_board/src/board_oled.c:23)

负责：

[board.h](/home/foam/vela/openvela/vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_295_board/include/board.h:99)

核心文件：

  负责初始化、显存、`putrun()`、亮度、电源、刷新等。

  驱动配置和接口定义。

一般不建议为了修改显示内容直接改这几个 NuttX 通用驱动文件。

### 3. 实际绘制文字的应用代码

#### `voice_echo` OLED

当前实际使用最直接的是：

[voice_echo_main.c](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/voice_echo/voice_echo_main.c:361)

- `voice_oled_init()`：初始化 OLED
- `voice_oled_show()` 的调用位置约在 1692 行以后

```text
REC / 3 SEC
ASR / REQ
ASR / DONE

PLAY
DONE

MIC ERROR
```

[voice_echo_main.c](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/voice_echo/voice_echo_main.c:377)

字体表位于该文件前部的 `g_font` 数组。

另一个文件是：

[agent_oled.c](/home/foam/vela/openvela/packages/ai_agent/src/ui/agent_oled.c:178)

它负责：

- 接收 LLM 最终文本

- 多页滚动显示

[agent_oled.h](/home/foam/vela/openvela/packages/ai_agent/src/ui/agent_oled.h:14)

```c
    uint32_t duration_ms);
```

不要让上层直接访问 OLED。

# 16. 多来源 Expression 状态

Manager 内部为每个 source 保存当前 request。

类似：

```c
struct robot_expression_request_s {
    bool active;

    enum robot_expression_e expression;

    int priority;

    uint64_t expire_at;

    uint32_t generation;
};
```

实际结构根据项目编码规范调整。

# 17. 第一阶段 priority

默认：

```text
SYSTEM error       = 100

AGENT semantic     = 70

VOICE              = 50

BEHAVIOR           = 40

MUSIC              = 30

IDLE               = 0
```

注意：

这些 priority 应该由 expression 模块统一定义。

不要让各调用者随便传：

```text
999999
```

如果保留 `priority` 参数，也必须 clamp / validate。

更推荐提供固定 source priority：

```text
priority = expression manager 根据 source 决定
```

这样调用者只提供：

```text
source
expression
duration
```

如果实现上方便，API 可设计成：

```c
robot_expression_set(
    source,
    expression,
    duration_ms);
```

Manager 内部决定 priority。

这是优先方案。

# 18. 仲裁规则

任何时刻：

```text
遍历所有 active source
       ↓
选择 priority 最高
       ↓
robot_oled 显示
```

例如：

```text
VOICE:
speaking
priority=50
active=true
```

Agent：

```text
happy
priority=70
duration=1500
```

最终：

```text
0ms        happy
1500ms     speaking
```

Agent happy 到期后：

**不能无脑恢复 idle。**

应该重新计算：

```text
当前所有 active request
```

发现 voice speaking 仍然 active：

```text
恢复 speaking
```

这是必须正确实现的核心行为。

# 19. duration 的正确实现

例如：

```text
Agent -> happy 5000ms
```

500ms 后：

```text
Agent -> thinking 1000ms
```

旧的 happy timeout：

```text
绝不能
```

在第 5 秒突然影响 thinking 或其他后续状态。

必须使用：

```text
generation
sequence number
request version
absolute expiration timestamp
```

等机制避免旧 timeout 覆盖新状态。

不要：

```c
sleep(duration_ms);
robot_expression_set(IDLE);
```

尤其不能在 Agent callback 中 sleep。

# 20. idle 的处理

`idle` 应当是：

```text
没有更高有效 request 时的默认显示
```

不建议要求每个 source 都主动 set idle。

例如：

```text
VOICE speaking active
```

TTS 完成：

```c
robot_expression_clear(
    ROBOT_EXPR_SOURCE_VOICE);
```

Manager 自动重新仲裁。

如果没有其他 source：

```text
OLED -> idle
```

这样比：

```c
robot_expression_set(VOICE, IDLE)
```

干净。

# openvela Build

编译 openvela 固件、修改内核配置、运行模拟器。

## 默认目标

默认编译目标为 goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap（64 位 ARM 模拟器）：

```
CONFIG_PATH=vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/
OUTPUT_DIR=cmake_out/vela_goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/
```

如果用户指定了其他板级配置路径，替换上述路径即可。

## 命令

### 编译

```bash
./build.sh <CONFIG_PATH> --cmake -j$(nproc)
```

示例：
```bash
./build.sh vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/ --cmake -j$(nproc)
```

**成功标志**: 输出 `#### build completed successfully`

**编译产物**: `<OUTPUT_DIR>/nuttx`（ELF）、`<OUTPUT_DIR>/vela_ap.bin`

### 修改内核配置（menuconfig）

```bash
./build.sh <CONFIG_PATH> --cmake menuconfig
```

menuconfig 是交互式 TUI 界面，**不能在 AI 终端中直接运行**。提示用户在自己的终端中执行。

修改配置后保存会自动更新 `.config`。如需持久化到 defconfig：
```bash
./build.sh <CONFIG_PATH> --cmake savedefconfig
```

### 运行模拟器

```bash
./emulator.sh <OUTPUT_DIR>
```

示例：
```bash
./emulator.sh cmake_out/vela_goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/
```

**成功标志**: 出现 `goldfish-armv8a-ap>` NSH 提示符

### 清理编译

```bash
rm -rf <OUTPUT_DIR>
```

全量清理后重新编译：
```bash
rm -rf cmake_out/vela_goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/ && ./build.sh vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/ --cmake -j$(nproc)
```

## 编译流程

1. 用户指定或确认目标配置路径
2. 执行 `./build.sh <path> --cmake -j$(nproc)`
3. 检查输出最后几行是否包含 `build completed successfully`
4. 如果编译失败，分析错误日志并尝试修复（最多 3 轮）

## 编译失败处理

| 错误类型 | 特征 | 处理 |
|----------|------|------|
| 代码错误 | `error:` + 本驱动文件名 | 自动修复代码，重新编译 |
| 配置缺失 | `undefined reference` + CONFIG 相关 | 提示用户 menuconfig 开启 |
| 工具链问题 | `command not found` | 提示用户安装工具链 |
| 缓存问题 | 奇怪的链接错误 | `rm -rf <OUTPUT_DIR>` 后重编 |

## 启用新驱动的 CONFIG

如果需要临时启用某个 CONFIG 进行编译验证：

```bash
# 方法 1: 直接追加到 defconfig（推荐）
echo "CONFIG_SENSORS_BME680=y" >> <CONFIG_PATH>/defconfig

# 方法 2: 用 sed 修改 .config（临时，不持久化）
sed -i 's/# CONFIG_SENSORS_BME680 is not set/CONFIG_SENSORS_BME680=y/' <OUTPUT_DIR>/.config
```

修改后重新编译即可。

## 常用配置路径

| 目标 | 配置路径 |
|------|----------|
| goldfish-arm64 (推荐) | `vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/` |
| goldfish-arm32 | `vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-armeabi-v7a-ap/` |
| 自定义板级 | `vendor/<vendor>/boards/<chip>/<board>/configs/<config>/` |

烧录后建议按以下顺序测试。

**1. 冷启动检查**

打开串口监视器，重启设备，等待出现：

```text
[RV-OLED] worker ready 128x64
[RV-EXPR] tool provider registered
[contest_voice] voice_channel_init
```

如果出现：

```text
[RV-OLED] board OLED unavailable
[RV-OLED] board OLED plane unavailable
```

说明 OLED 初始化失败，先检查 OLED 接线和配置。

**2. 配置网络和模型**

```text
set_wifi <ssid> <password>
set_llm https://token-plan-cn.xiaomimimo.com/v1 mimo-v2.5 <api_key>
set_voice_asr mimo-v2.5-asr
set_voice_tts mimo-v2.5-tts
```

确认网络已经连接后再测试。

**3. 测试 AI 表情 Tool**

执行：

```text
ask 仅调用 robot_set_expression，把表情设置为 happy，持续 3000 毫秒，不要调用其他工具
```

期望日志：

```text
[RV-EXPR] set source=1 expression=happy duration=3000
```

OLED 应显示开心表情，约 3 秒后自动恢复 `idle`。

依次测试：

```text
ask 仅调用 robot_set_expression，把表情设置为 listening
ask 仅调用 robot_set_expression，把表情设置为 thinking
ask 仅调用 robot_set_expression，把表情设置为 speaking
ask 仅调用 robot_set_expression，把表情设置为 error
ask 仅调用 robot_set_expression，把表情设置为 idle
```

注意，当前没有新增 NSH 表情命令，表情通过 Agent 的 `robot_set_expression` Tool 调用。

**4. 测试语音生命周期**

```text
voice_start
```

说话时应看到：

```text
[RV-EXPR] set source=2 expression=listening
```

ASR 成功并提交给 Agent 后：

```text
[RV-EXPR] set source=2 expression=thinking
```

TTS 播放时：

```text
[RV-EXPR] set source=2 expression=speaking
```

播放结束后，VOICE 表情应被清除并回到 `idle`。

停止连续语音：

```text
voice_stop
```

**5. 测试错误状态**

可让 ASR、TTS 或网络请求失败，确认出现：

```text
[RV-EXPR] set source=0 expression=error duration=1500
```

约 1.5 秒后自动恢复默认表情。

当前 OLED 显示链路主要由以下文件负责：

1. **板级 SSD1306 初始化**

[board_oled.c](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/board/contest_board/src/board_oled.c:23)

负责：

- 初始化 ESP32-S3 I2C0
- 初始化 SSD1306
- 设置 OLED 电源
- 提供 `board_oled_getdev()`

2. **OLED 硬件发送和线程队列**

[robot_oled.c](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/robot_expression/robot_oled.c:52)

负责：

- 创建 OLED worker 线程
- 维护显示队列
- 获取 LCD plane
- 调用 `putrun()` 将帧发送到 SSD1306
- 处理 128x64 单色帧缓存

如果要修改“如何向 OLED 刷新数据”，主要改这个文件。

3. **表情图形绘制**

[robot_oled_expr.c](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/robot_expression/robot_oled_expr.c:151)

负责绘制：

- `idle`
- `listening`
- `thinking`
- `happy`
- `speaking`
- `error`

如果要修改眼睛、嘴巴、表情图案，主要改这个文件。

4. **表情状态管理**

[robot_expression.c](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/robot_expression/robot_expression.c:33)

负责：

- 表情优先级
- 表情持续时间
- 超时恢复
- `SYSTEM/AGENT/VOICE/BEHAVIOR/MUSIC` 来源仲裁

5. **AI Agent 表情工具**

[robot_expression_tool.c](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/robot_expression/robot_expression_tool.c:1)

负责向 AI Agent 注册 `robot_set_expression` 工具，使 LLM 可以调用 OLED 表情。

6. **语音链路触发表情**

[robot_voice_main.c](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/robot_voice/robot_voice_main.c:258)

负责在以下阶段切换表情：

- 开始录音：`listening`
- ASR 完成、等待 LLM：`thinking`
- TTS 播放：`speaking`
- ASR/TTS/网络失败：`error`
- 完成后恢复：`idle`

构建集成文件是：

- [robot_voice/Makefile](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/robot_voice/Makefile:14)
- [robot_voice/CMakeLists.txt](/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app/robot_voice/CMakeLists.txt:6)

实际修改表情图案时，优先编辑 `robot_oled_expr.c`；修改显示线程、刷新机制或 I2C LCD 输出时，编辑 `robot_oled.c`；不要修改构建生成的 `.o` 文件。

# 任务名称

抽象通用 `robot_action_guard`，统一解决机器人实体 Side-Effect Tool 被 AI Agent LLM Cache 跳过的问题。

---

# 0. 项目位置与强制边界

```bash
cd /home/foam/vela/openvela
git status --short
```

记录当前已有修改。

要求：

# 2. 当前已验证事实

当前系统已经具备稳定的：

```text
MiMo Agent
→ Tool Provider
→ robot_set_expression
→ robot_expression
→ robot_oled
→ SSD1306
```

并且已经验证：

```text
ai_agent 启动
→ OLED 自动显示 idle

连接 Wi-Fi
→ 稳定，无 CPU1 panic

ask happy
→ Tool Call
→ OLED happy

ask thinking
→ Tool Call
→ OLED thinking
```

Expression 使用：

```text
duration_ms = 0
```

表示：

```text
保持当前表情，直到下一次表情请求覆盖
```

这个行为必须保留。

---

# 3. 当前已经发现并验证的问题

AI Agent 存在 LLM response cache。

当第一次执行：

```text
ask thinking
```

流程：

```text
LLM
→ robot_set_expression Tool Call
→ OLED 更新
→ 最终文本回答
→ response 被 cache
```

之后再次：

```text
ask thinking
```

可能出现：

```text
[agent] Cache hit (successful answer), skipping LLM call
```

于是：

```text
直接返回旧文本
→ 不进入 LLM
→ 不产生 Tool Call
→ 不执行实体动作
```

这对于实体机器人是错误语义。

核心原则：

```text
缓存文字结果
≠
重新执行真实世界动作
```

---

# 4. 当前已经验证稳定的 workaround

目前 `robot_expression_tool.c` 内已经实现了一个稳定版本：

```text
Tool 真正执行之后
→ llm_cache_invalidate()
→ 开启约 30 秒 cache guard
→ guard active 时约每 100ms invalidate
→ 覆盖 Agent Tool 后续 final-answer/cache-put 阶段
```

已经在硬件上验证：

```text
连续多次 ask happy/thinking/error/idle
```

可以稳定重新产生 Tool Call。

本任务不要重新发明另一套机制。

目标是：

```text
把当前 expression-specific cache guard
抽象成通用 robot_action_guard
```

---

# 5. 总体目标架构

最终形成：

```text
                     AI Agent
                        │
                     Tool Call
                        │
          ┌─────────────┼──────────────┐
          │             │              │
          ▼             ▼              ▼
 robot_set_expression robot_move  robot_behavior
          │             │              │
          └─────────────┼──────────────┘
                        ▼
              robot_action_guard
                  │           │
               begin()      end()
                  │           │
                  └─────┬─────┘
                        ▼
               LLM Cache Protection
                        │
              llm_cache_invalidate()
                        │
                        ▼
                Physical Action
```

其中：

```text
robot_action_guard
```

只负责 Side-Effect / Cache 保护。

它绝对不负责：

```text
OLED
servo
walk
dance
tail
head
music
LLM JSON parsing
behavior arbitration
```

# 9. 为什么必须有 begin + end

标准时序：

```text
User request
    ↓
MiMo Tool selection
    ↓
Tool callback
    ↓
robot_action_guard_begin()
    ↓
llm_cache_invalidate()
    ↓
physical action
    ↓
robot_action_guard_end()
    ↓
Tool result
    ↓
Agent final LLM answer
    ↓
llm_cache_put()
    ↓
guard worker 再次 invalidate
```

不能只：

```text
action success
→ invalidate 一次
```

因为 Agent 有可能在 Tool 返回以后又写入 final answer cache。

---

# 10. Failure 也必须 Guard

例如：

```text
ask forward
```

第一次：

```text
Tool Call
→ servo busy
→ failed
```

如果失败文本进入 cache：

```text
ask forward
```

第二次就可能：

```text
Cache hit
→ 返回旧的 failed
→ 完全不重新尝试机器人动作
```

因此规则：

```text
进入 Side-Effect Tool 后：
成功需要 Guard
失败也需要 Guard
```

```text
LLM response cache
```

```text
Cached text ≠ replayed physical action
```

# openvela Build

编译 openvela 固件、修改内核配置、运行模拟器。

## 默认目标

默认编译目标为 goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap（64 位 ARM 模拟器）：

```
CONFIG_PATH=vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/
OUTPUT_DIR=cmake_out/vela_goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/
```

如果用户指定了其他板级配置路径，替换上述路径即可。

## 命令

### 编译

```bash
./build.sh <CONFIG_PATH> --cmake -j$(nproc)
```

示例：
```bash
./build.sh vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/ --cmake -j$(nproc)
```

**成功标志**: 输出 `#### build completed successfully`

**编译产物**: `<OUTPUT_DIR>/nuttx`（ELF）、`<OUTPUT_DIR>/vela_ap.bin`

### 修改内核配置（menuconfig）

```bash
./build.sh <CONFIG_PATH> --cmake menuconfig
```

menuconfig 是交互式 TUI 界面，**不能在 AI 终端中直接运行**。提示用户在自己的终端中执行。

修改配置后保存会自动更新 `.config`。如需持久化到 defconfig：
```bash
./build.sh <CONFIG_PATH> --cmake savedefconfig
```

### 运行模拟器

```bash
./emulator.sh <OUTPUT_DIR>
```

示例：
```bash
./emulator.sh cmake_out/vela_goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/
```

**成功标志**: 出现 `goldfish-armv8a-ap>` NSH 提示符

### 清理编译

```bash
rm -rf <OUTPUT_DIR>
```

全量清理后重新编译：
```bash
rm -rf cmake_out/vela_goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/ && ./build.sh vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/ --cmake -j$(nproc)
```

## 编译流程

1. 用户指定或确认目标配置路径
2. 执行 `./build.sh <path> --cmake -j$(nproc)`
3. 检查输出最后几行是否包含 `build completed successfully`
4. 如果编译失败，分析错误日志并尝试修复（最多 3 轮）

## 编译失败处理

| 错误类型 | 特征 | 处理 |
|----------|------|------|
| 代码错误 | `error:` + 本驱动文件名 | 自动修复代码，重新编译 |
| 配置缺失 | `undefined reference` + CONFIG 相关 | 提示用户 menuconfig 开启 |
| 工具链问题 | `command not found` | 提示用户安装工具链 |
| 缓存问题 | 奇怪的链接错误 | `rm -rf <OUTPUT_DIR>` 后重编 |

## 启用新驱动的 CONFIG

如果需要临时启用某个 CONFIG 进行编译验证：

```bash
# 方法 1: 直接追加到 defconfig（推荐）
echo "CONFIG_SENSORS_BME680=y" >> <CONFIG_PATH>/defconfig

# 方法 2: 用 sed 修改 .config（临时，不持久化）
sed -i 's/# CONFIG_SENSORS_BME680 is not set/CONFIG_SENSORS_BME680=y/' <OUTPUT_DIR>/.config
```

修改后重新编译即可。

## 常用配置路径

| 目标 | 配置路径 |
|------|----------|
| goldfish-arm64 (推荐) | `vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/` |
| goldfish-arm32 | `vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-armeabi-v7a-ap/` |
| 自定义板级 | `vendor/<vendor>/boards/<chip>/<board>/configs/<config>/` |

# 任务目标

当前机器狗已经通过 NSH 支持：

```text
robotctl forward|backward|left|right [steps] [period_ms]
```

现有约束：

```text
steps:     1..10
period_ms: 800..3000
```

使用现有：

```text
POWER_SAFE gait
```

完成运动。

现在需要把这套已经验证工作的运动实现抽象成一个正式的机器人能力：

```text
robot_motion
```

并提供 AI Agent Tool：

```text
robot_move
```

最终目标：

```text
NSH robotctl ───────┐
                    │
                    ▼
               robot_motion
                    ▲
                    │
AI robot_move Tool ─┘
        │
        ▼
robot_action_guard
```

要求：

1. NSH 原来的 `robotctl forward/backward/left/right` 功能保持。
2. Agent 可以通过 Tool 调用相同运动能力。
3. NSH 与 Agent 不得各自拥有一套独立 gait 实现。
4. LLM 不得控制单个舵机角度。
5. LLM 不得输出 raw servo angle。
6. 所有运动 Tool 都必须接入现有 `robot_action_guard`。
7. 不得修改官方 SDK 代码。

---

```text
tools/**
```

```bash
git status --short
```

```text
git reset
git checkout .
git clean
```

不得覆盖用户已有修改。

---

# 2. 首先调查 robotctl 当前实现

在编码之前，先只读搜索：

```bash
grep -R "robotctl" contest2026_295_suanliheidong -n
grep -R "POWER_SAFE" contest2026_295_suanliheidong -n
grep -R "forward" contest2026_295_suanliheidong/app -n
```

找到：

```text
robotctl forward
robotctl backward
robotctl left
robotctl right
```

最终真正调用的 gait / servo 代码。

必须回答：

1. `robotctl` CLI 文件在哪里。
2. forward/backward/left/right 对应哪个真实 C 函数。
3. gait 函数当前是否是 `static`。
4. gait 是否同步阻塞。
5. 一个 step 大约是否等于一个 `period_ms`。
6. 当前默认 `steps` 是多少。
7. 当前默认 `period_ms` 是多少。
8. 当前是否已有全局 servo mutex / motion busy 状态。
9. 当前运动中是否支持安全取消。
10. `home` 和 `off` 当前具体如何实现。

不要根据名字猜。

必须根据现有源码确认。

---

# 3. 重要原则：不要通过 NSH 字符串执行运动

禁止这种设计：

```c
system("robotctl forward 2 1200");
```

禁止：

```c
nsh_execute("robotctl forward ...");
```

禁止拼字符串：

```text
"robotctl " + LLM argument
```

Agent 不应该依赖 shell parser 来控制实体机器人。

正确方式：

```text
robotctl CLI
      ↓
shared C API
      ↑
robot_move Tool
```

---

# 4. 如果 robotctl 的 gait 逻辑当前是 static

如果发现类似：

```c
static int robot_forward(...)
static int robot_backward(...)
```

并且文件位于：

```text
contest2026_295_suanliheidong/**
```

允许进行 contest-local 重构：

把真正 gait / motion 逻辑抽到共享模块。

例如：

```text
app/robot_motion/
├── robot_motion.h
├── robot_motion.c
├── robot_motion_tool.h
├── robot_motion_tool.c
└── README.md
```

如果需要进一步分离底层：

```text
robot_motion_backend.h
robot_motion_backend.c
```

也可以。

但是不要为了形式过度拆文件。

---

# 5. NSH robotctl 必须成为共享 API 的调用者

重构后不能：

```text
robotctl 自己一套 forward 实现
robot_motion 自己复制一套 forward 实现
```

必须：

```text
                   robot_motion
                  /            \
             robotctl        Agent Tool
```

例如：

```c
/* robotctl */

ret = robot_motion_submit(
    ROBOT_MOTION_SOURCE_CLI,
    ROBOT_MOTION_FORWARD,
    steps,
    period_ms);
```

Agent：

```c
ret = robot_motion_submit(
    ROBOT_MOTION_SOURCE_AGENT,
    ROBOT_MOTION_FORWARD,
    steps,
    period_ms);
```

底层 gait 只有一份。

虽然当前 NSH 支持：

```text
robotctl servo <lf|lr|rf|rr|tail> <angle>
```

这个接口只用于：

建议增加：

```c
enum robot_motion_source_e
{
  ROBOT_MOTION_SOURCE_SYSTEM = 0,
  ROBOT_MOTION_SOURCE_CLI,
  ROBOT_MOTION_SOURCE_AGENT,
  ROBOT_MOTION_SOURCE_BEHAVIOR,
};
```

当前使用：

```text
CLI
AGENT
```

`BEHAVIOR` 留给未来：

```text
dance
greet
follow
proactive movement
```

# 9. Motion State

至少支持：

```c
enum robot_motion_state_e
{
  ROBOT_MOTION_STATE_IDLE = 0,
  ROBOT_MOTION_STATE_RUNNING,
  ROBOT_MOTION_STATE_ERROR,
};
```

不要把方向当 state。

运行中的 request 单独保存：

```c
struct robot_motion_request_s
{
  enum robot_motion_source_e source;
  enum robot_motion_direction_e direction;

  unsigned int steps;
  unsigned int period_ms;

  uint32_t request_id;
};
```

---

# 10. 推荐公共 API

建议：

```c
int robot_motion_init(void);

int robot_motion_submit(
    enum robot_motion_source_e source,
    enum robot_motion_direction_e direction,
    unsigned int steps,
    unsigned int period_ms);

bool robot_motion_is_busy(void);

enum robot_motion_state_e
robot_motion_get_state(void);
```

可选：

```c
int robot_motion_get_active(
    struct robot_motion_request_s *request);
```

---

# 11. 不要急着实现 robot_motion_stop()

先检查现有 gait 是否真正支持：

```text
safe cancellation
```

只有现有底层明确支持安全中断时，才允许实现：

```c
robot_motion_stop()
```

不要简单用：

```text
servo PWM off
```

伪装成 stop。

因为当前：

```text
robotctl off
```

语义是：

```text
Stop all servo PWM output
```

而且已有提示：

```text
Gear resistance can remain after PWM is stopped.
```

它不是等价于：

```text
安全停止步态并稳定站立
```

因此本任务第一版：

```text
不要向 LLM 暴露 off
不要向 LLM 暴露 servo-off
```

`robot_stop` 留到真正设计安全停止策略之后。

```text
robotctl home
```

# 13. 强烈建议使用 Motion Worker

需要先确认现有 gait 是否同步阻塞。

由于最大允许：

```text
steps = 10
period_ms = 3000
```

一次 motion 理论上可能执行较长时间。

因此不要让 Agent Tool callback 长时间直接执行整套 gait。

推荐：

```text
Tool callback
    ↓
robot_motion_submit()
    ↓
queue request
    ↓
立即返回 accepted
    ↓
Motion Worker
    ↓
执行 POWER_SAFE gait
```

结构：

```text
Agent Thread                 Motion Worker

robot_move
   │
   ▼
validate
   │
   ▼
submit ────────────────────► request
   │                           │
   ▼                           ▼
Tool result                 gait
                            execution
```

# 15. Motion Manager 第一版建议只允许一个动作

第一版不要建立无限动作队列。

```text

接受一个 motion

RUNNING
 ↓
执行完成
 ↓
IDLE
```

如果当前：



```json
  "error": "motion_busy"
}
```

推荐：

```text

    ↓
create one worker
```

# 18. 推荐同步结构

可使用：

```text
pthread_mutex_t
pthread_cond_t
```

状态：

```c
struct robot_motion_context_s
{
  pthread_mutex_t lock;
  pthread_cond_t cond;

  pthread_t worker;

  bool initialized;
  bool worker_started;
  bool request_pending;

  enum robot_motion_state_e state;

  struct robot_motion_request_s request;

  uint32_t next_request_id;

  int last_result;
};
```

---

# 19. Worker 基本逻辑

参考：

```c
for (;;)
  {
    lock();

    while (!request_pending)
      {
        pthread_cond_wait(...);
      }

    request = global_request;
    request_pending = false;
    state = ROBOT_MOTION_STATE_RUNNING;

    unlock();

    ret = execute_existing_power_safe_gait(&request);

    lock();

    last_result = ret;

    if (ret < 0)
      state = ROBOT_MOTION_STATE_ERROR;
    else
      state = ROBOT_MOTION_STATE_IDLE;

    /*
     * ERROR 是否立即回 IDLE，根据现有项目风格决定。
     * 不要引入复杂状态机。
     */

    unlock();
  }
```

# 27. 接入 robot_action_guard

合法 motion request：

```c
robot_action_guard_begin(
    ROBOT_ACTION_MOTION,
    "robot_move");

ret = robot_motion_submit(
    ROBOT_MOTION_SOURCE_AGENT,
    direction,
    steps,
    period_ms);

robot_action_guard_end(
    ROBOT_ACTION_MOTION,
    "robot_move",
    ret);
```

注意：

这里 `end()` 表示：

```text
Tool side-effect operation 返回
```

如果 motion 使用异步 worker：

```text

```

表示：

```text
request accepted
```

不表示实际步态已经全部走完。

这是正确语义。

# 3. 当前已经发现并验证的问题

AI Agent 存在 LLM response cache。

当第一次执行：

```text
ask thinking
```

流程：

```text
LLM
→ robot_set_expression Tool Call
→ OLED 更新
→ 最终文本回答
→ response 被 cache
```

之后再次：

```text
ask thinking
```

可能出现：

```text
[agent] Cache hit (successful answer), skipping LLM call
```

于是：

```text
直接返回旧文本
→ 不进入 LLM
→ 不产生 Tool Call
→ 不执行实体动作
```

这对于实体机器人是错误语义。

核心原则：

```text
缓存文字结果
≠
重新执行真实世界动作
```

# robot_motion

`robot_motion` is the single contest-local capability for the four validated
POWER_SAFE gaits: `forward`, `backward`, `left`, and `right`.

Both `robotctl` and the Agent `robot_move` Tool use this module. The Agent
Tool submits one asynchronous request and returns `accepted=true`; the worker
executes the gait and rejects a second request with `-EBUSY`. The legacy
`robotctl` commands keep their synchronous behavior by waiting for completion.

The Agent Tool accepts only semantic directions and bounded `steps` and
`period_ms` values. It never accepts servo names or angles. Valid physical
requests enter `robot_action_guard` before submission and leave it whether the
submission succeeds or fails.

# 任务目标

当前已经确认：

```text
robotctl left 1 3000
```

在不运行 `ai_agent` 时稳定，不会 Brownout。

但：

```text
ai_agent + Wi-Fi
→ ask 向左转
```

会：

```text
BROWNOUT_RST
```

因此 gait 本身不是首要问题。

当前日志显示：

```text
robot_move Tool
→ robot_motion_submit()
→ Tool 很快返回
→ Motion Worker 开始 servo gait

同时

Agent ReAct
→ Tool result
→ 第二次 LLM HTTP/HTTPS 请求
```

导致：

```text
Servo current peak
+
Wi-Fi TX / HTTPS
+
CPU load
```

发生功耗峰值重叠。

本任务目标：

**通过 contest-local 软件调度，让 AI Agent 的高网络负载和 servo motion 错峰执行。**

不要修改 gait table。

不要修改官方 Agent。

不要关闭 Brownout detector。

---

# 1. 修改范围

只允许：

```text
/home/foam/vela/openvela/contest2026_295_suanliheidong/**
```

官方代码全部只读。

开始：

```bash
cd /home/foam/vela/openvela
git status --short
```

---

# 2. 保留现有架构

不要重新设计：

```text
robot_action_guard
robot_motion
robot_move Tool
robot_expression
OLED
```

特别保留：

```text
single motion worker
single active motion
POWER_SAFE gait
```

---

# 3. 核心修改：增加同步等待接口

在 `robot_motion` 增加类似：

```c
int robot_motion_submit_and_wait(
    enum robot_motion_source_e source,
    enum robot_motion_direction_e direction,
    unsigned int steps,
    unsigned int period_ms,
    uint32_t timeout_ms);
```

具体签名可按现有代码风格微调。

语义：

```text
submit request
→ motion worker executes
→ caller waits for this request_id completion
→ return final gait result
```

禁止：

```text
caller直接执行servo gait
```

仍然必须由现有 Motion Worker 唯一执行。

---

# 4. request completion

现有 request 增加 completion 信息。

可以使用：

```text
request_id
completed_request_id
last_result
pthread_cond
```

例如：

```c
robot_motion_submit(...)
→ request_id = 12

robot_motion_wait(12)
→ cond_wait

worker finishes request 12
→ last_result = rc
→ completed_request_id = 12
→ cond_broadcast
```

必须处理：

```text
spurious wakeup
timeout
错误返回
```

等待条件必须在循环里检查。

---

# 5. 不允许持 lock 执行 gait

必须保持：

```text
lock
update/copy request
unlock

execute POWER_SAFE gait

lock
publish completion
cond_broadcast
unlock
```

---

# 6. Agent Tool 改成 Power-Safe 同步语义

当前大概：

```text
guard_begin
→ robot_motion_submit
→ guard_end
→ Tool returns accepted
```

改成：

```text
robot_action_guard_begin(MOTION)

→ robot_motion_submit_and_wait(...)

robot_action_guard_end(MOTION, rc)

→ Tool returns
```

这样 Agent 在 Tool callback 没返回以前：

```text
不能开始下一次 ReAct LLM 请求
```

从而把：

```text
Wi-Fi HTTPS
```

与：

```text
servo gait
```

错开。

---

# 7. Tool 成功语义同步调整

以前异步返回：

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "accepted": true
}
```

同步完成后应返回类似：

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "completed": true,
  "direction": "left",
  "steps": 1,
  "period_ms": 3000
}
```

Agent 可以在之后自然回复：

```text
已完成左转。
```

---

# 8. 第一阶段限制 Agent motion 为短动作

核心 `robot_motion` 和 `robotctl` 保持：

```text
steps = 1..10
```

但是 Agent `robot_move` 第一阶段限制：

```text
steps = 1
```

或者如果当前 schema 兼容性要求范围：

```text
minimum = 1
maximum = 1
```

目标是首先验证：

```text
forward one step
backward one step
left one turn
right one turn
```

在 AI + Wi-Fi 环境下全部无 Brownout。

不要修改 NSH：

```text
robotctl ... 1..10
```

能力。

---

# 9. Timeout

根据当前真实 gait 时序计算合理 timeout。

不要写无限等待。

例如原则：

```text
timeout >
steps * period_ms
+ HOME/preparation margin
+ small safety margin
```

使用 `CLOCK_MONOTONIC`。

具体值由现有 gait 实现决定。

如果 timeout：

```text
返回 -ETIMEDOUT
```

但不得通过强行杀 worker 或关闭 PWM“修复”。

---

# 10. robot_action_guard 保留

仍然：

```text
robot_action_guard_begin()
...
robot_action_guard_end()
```

即使 gait failure / timeout 也必须 end。

不要删除 cache protection。

---

# 11. OLED 不需要关闭

不要为了省电：

```text
关闭 OLED
```

OLED 应继续用于动作反馈。

例如 Motion Tool 开始以后，未来可以显示：

```text
happy / active
```

但本任务不要新增表情联动。

当前只确保 OLED 不受影响。

---

# 12. Voice/TTS 不要与 Motion 重叠

如果当前 voice pipeline 在 Tool 执行完成后才生成 final answer/TTS，则自然保持：

```text
motion
→ final LLM
→ TTS
```

不要新增：

```text
motion期间主动TTS
```

第一阶段优先稳定电源。

---

# 13. 可选第二层：Wi-Fi TX Power Profile

只读调查当前 SDK 是否能从 contest-local 使用：

```c
esp_wifi_get_max_tx_power()
esp_wifi_set_max_tx_power()
```

不要修改官方 Wi-Fi source。

如果当前构建能够合法 include/link：

```text
robot_power_profile
```

或简单内部 helper。

```text
read current Wi-Fi TX power
save original
```


ESP-IDF 参数单位为 0.25 dBm：


运动完成后：

```text
restore exact saved TX power
```

---

# 14. Wi-Fi Power 调整必须 Fail-Open

如果：

```text
Wi-Fi未启动
API unavailable
get/set失败
```

必须：

```text
log
continue motion
```

禁止：

```text

disconnect Wi-Fi
```

```text
不产生大网络流量

可选降低TX power
```

# 16. 不要依赖 Modem Sleep 单独解决 Brownout

允许检查当前：

```text
WIFI_PS_MIN_MODEM
WIFI_PS_MAX_MODEM
```

配置。

但本任务不要把 Modem Sleep 当作主修复。

它主要减少 Wi-Fi idle/average power。

主动 HTTPS TX 期间仍存在 RF current peak。

# 17. 可选未来模块：robot_power_budget

本任务暂时只写 README/设计，不必实现完整 manager。

未来规则：

```text
ROBOT_POWER_NETWORK
ROBOT_POWER_MOTION
ROBOT_POWER_AUDIO
```

第一版预算：

```text
NETWORK + MOTION = avoid
AUDIO   + MOTION = avoid
OLED    + MOTION = allowed
```

目标交互：

```text
Listen
→ ASR
→ LLM
→ Motion
→ LLM final response
→ TTS
```

而不是：

```text
LLM HTTPS + Servo + Speaker
```

同时发生。

-executes the gait and rejects a second request with `-EBUSY`. The legacy
-`robotctl` commands keep their synchronous behavior by waiting for completion.
+Both `robotctl` and the Agent `robot_move` Tool use this module. The Agent
+Tool submits one request and waits for the worker to finish before returning
+`completed=true`; a second request is rejected with `-EBUSY`. The legacy
+`robotctl` commands keep their synchronous behavior by waiting for completion.
+
+Agent requests are limited to one gait step. The wait timeout is derived from
+the requested period plus a fixed home/settle margin and is capped at two
+minutes. A timeout never cancels the worker; the worker retains ownership of
+the active request until it completes.

# 5. 重点：区别“耗能”和“峰值”

当前最可能导致 Brownout 的不是单纯：

```text
动作总能量
```

而是：

```text
多个 servo
在很短时间内同时加速 / 持力
```

产生瞬时峰值。

因此优化优先目标：

```text
降低 peak current
```

而不是：

```text
无限降低整体速度
```

---

# 6. 优先优化一：跳过 NO-OP Servo Command

检查当前是否存在：

```text
current = 90
target  = 90
```

仍然执行：

```text
servo_set_angle(90)
```

类似之前日志：

```text
LF 90 -> 90
RF 90 -> 90
LR 90 -> 90
RR 90 -> 90
TAIL 85 -> 85
```

如果 software state 可以可靠判断当前位置，则增加：

```text
current == target
→ skip physical write
```

例如：

```c
if (current_angle == target_angle)
  {
    return 0;
  }
```

但必须确认：

```text
software current angle
```

# 7. 建议增加 Servo Runtime State

如果当前没有明确状态，可在 contest-local motion/backend 增加：

```c
struct robot_servo_runtime_s
{
  int current_angle;
  bool angle_known;
  bool pwm_enabled;

```


# 8. 优先优化二：检查每次 Motion 是否真的需要 HOME

当前：

```text
forward/backward/left/right
```

如果每次都：

```text
当前姿态
→ HOME
→ gait
```

会产生大量额外运动和电流。

需要检查：

```text
POWER_SAFE gait
```

是否真正要求每次进入 HOME。

如果：

```text
前一个动作结束姿态
```

已经是合法 gait 起始姿态，

则优先：

```text
直接进入下一动作
```

而不是：

```text
重新 HOME
```

---

# 9. HOME 不允许简单删除

如果 gait 安全依赖 HOME：

```text
必须保留
```

但可以优化：

```text
已经在 HOME tolerance 内的 servo
→ 不移动
```

例如：

```text
abs(current - home) <= tolerance
→ skip
```

tolerance 必须非常小，例如：

```text
1–2°
```

并根据当前 servo 精度决定。

不要使用大 tolerance 导致姿态积累偏差。

---

# 10. 优先优化三：TAIL 与 locomotion 解耦

检查：

```text
forward
backward
left
right
```

是否真正需要：

```text
TAIL
```

如果 locomotion gait 不需要 tail：

禁止为了：

```text
HOME
motion init
phase preparation
```

重复驱动 tail。

TAIL 应由未来：

```text
robot_behavior
```

单独控制。

但是：

```text
robotctl home
```

仍可恢复 tail home。

---

# 11. 优先优化四：多舵机错峰启动

这是本任务最重要的优化之一。

禁止出现：

```text
T=0ms LF开始
T=0ms RF开始
T=0ms LR开始
T=0ms RR开始
```

这种多个高负载 servo 同时起动。

改成 Power-Aware stagger：

```text
T=0ms    servo A starts
T=Δ      servo B starts
T=2Δ     servo C starts
...
```

第一版建议提供参数：

```c
#define ROBOT_MOTION_SERVO_START_STAGGER_MS ...
```

不要直接拍脑袋固定最终值。

根据当前 gait 调查，从：

```text
10–30 ms
```

量级进行保守板测。

# 12. 错峰不是把整个 gait 串行化

目标不是：

```text
servo1走完
→ servo2走完
→ servo3走完
```

这样会非常慢。

目标是：

```text
servo1 start
  ↓ 20ms
servo2 start
  ↓ 20ms
servo3 start
```

然后允许它们部分重叠。

即：

调查 gait 后，可以引入：

```c
#define ROBOT_MOTION_MAX_ACTIVE_SERVOS 2
```

而是：

```text
同一个加速窗口
最多允许 N 个 servo 进入明显位置变化
```

第一版推荐尝试：


# 14. 优先优化五：加入加速度限制，而不是降低最高速度

当前：


问题通常最严重的是：

```text

→ 第一帧立即高速
```

以及：

```text
高速
→ 突然停止
```

建议增加简单：

```text
start ramp
cruise
end ramp
```
